newsitem.title: USA: FMR group cuts KLM ADS stake to 10.57 pct.
newsitem.headline: FMR group cuts KLM ADS stake to 10.57 pct.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp, the parent of the investment adviser to Fidelity Funds, said on Tuesday that it reduced its stake in KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV to 1,278,587 American Depositary Shares, or 10.57 percent of the class outstanding.
FMR disclosed its latest position in KLM in a 13G filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
On May 13, the FMR group said it held a 17.92 percent, or 2,182,330 ADSs of KLM.
A 13G filing signifies the filer has "passive" investment objectives in the subject company. The short-form filing does not include details of the filer's latest transactions.
